items.title: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
items.summary: This research paper introduces Stable Gated DeltaNet-2, a novel approach to address and reduce recurrent state instability in neural networks, improving model reliability.

items.title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
items.summary: Researchers present OS-Omni, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of generalist AI agents in complex, multi-step computer-based tasks across various operating systems.

items.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.summary: Nvidia has temporarily halted chip shipments to Southeast Asia, a move that could significantly impact the region's burgeoning AI and tech industries.

items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
items.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, publicly refutes claims that his company's AI development path involves relinquishing human control, emphasizing safety and alignment.

items.title: Solve Vision with Code: Coding Agents Are Stronger Visual Reasoners Than Video Models
items.summary: A new paper suggests that AI coding agents, by leveraging programmatic reasoning, can outperform traditional video models in complex visual reasoning tasks.

items.title: What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models
items.summary: This paper introduces a forecasting leaderboard and resolution reporting methodology to better evaluate zero-shot time-series models, enhancing transparency and comparability.

items.title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
items.summary: Researchers introduce ProxyGenBench, a new benchmark for evaluating the quality and effectiveness of proxy-guided video generation models.

items.title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
items.summary: The Entangle framework proposes a method for scaling human-video in-context world-action models to perform effectively across a wide range of novel tasks and environments.

items.title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
items.summary: StateWeaver presents a novel system for multi-agent coordination that enables coherent and long-horizon video generation by managing story-state transitions.

items.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
items.summary: This research explores a new technique allowing vision-language models to generate images directly from their internal representations, bypassing traditional generative pipelines.

items.title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
items.summary: DRBench Pro is introduced as a new knowledge-centric benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the capabilities of professional deep research AI agents.

items.title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
items.summary: DexEngine offers a method to scale human demonstrations into comprehensive, physically executable datasets for whole-robot control, advancing robotic learning.

items.title: The Zombie Ticket: Deleting a Chatbot Conversation Doesn't Delete It
items.summary: This article highlights a critical privacy concern where deleting chatbot conversations may not fully erase the data, raising questions about data retention policies.

items.title: Under the Hood of Google Cloud Data Agent Kit: MCP Tools, SKILL.md Playbooks & Custom Guardrails
items.summary: A deep dive into Google Cloud's Data Agent Kit reveals its architecture, including MCP Tools, SKILL.md Playbooks, and custom guardrails for robust data agent deployment.

items.title: Your On-Device AI Works Offline. Does Your Web App?
items.summary: This piece explores the growing trend of on-device AI capabilities and challenges developers to ensure their web applications can also function effectively offline.
